programmes.title: CertHE in Common Law
programmes.duration: One year (the first year of the University of London LLB, 120 credits)
programmes.assessment: University of London examinations. Final examinations are conducted by the British Council, Dhaka, and marked and certified by the University of London.
entry: Five O Levels with at least four C grades, or
SSC and HSC with one 1st division and one 2nd division (old system), or
A total GPA of 5 or more (minimum 2 SSC + 2 HSC + 1).
The Academy may require a written English test and a viva.
programmes.nextStep: Ask a student counsellor to check your results against these routes.
programmes.note: Can lead to the University of London LLB, subject to progression. The Academy was the first institution in Bangladesh permitted by the University of London to run this programme (earlier: Diploma in Law).

programmes.title: LL.B (Hons)
programmes.forWhom: The classic route to a UK law degree from Dhaka.
programmes.assessment: University of London examinations. Final examinations are conducted by the British Council, Dhaka, and marked and certified by the University of London.
entry: Meet the University of London General Entrance Requirements for international students, and
(a) a minimum C in 3 O Levels and 2 A Levels, or
(b) a minimum C in 1 O Level and 3 A Levels.
Apply to the University of London for registration through the Academy.
programmes.nextStep: Admissions are open for the October 2027 assessment cycle. Ask us for the registration steps.
